description: A rule the Cohort Planner can apply when it proposes cohorts. Filters decide which mentors a student may be given to; Rankings order the mentors who qualify. The catalog ships with the app: you choose which rules a Cohort Type uses, rename them for your school, and retire the ones you do not want.

fields.description: A Filter decides who may be paired: a mentor it rejects is not offered for that student at all. A Ranking never rejects anybody, it puts the mentors who qualify in order. Rules are applied in the order they are listed on the Cohort Type.
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: The rule this record runs. It is part of the program, not a setting, so the name above can be changed freely without changing what the rule does.
fields.label: Handler

fields.description: The personal detail this rule reads. A person missing it cannot be matched by this rule, which is what the planner's readiness check reports before a run.
fields.label: Reads

fields.description: Uncheck to withdraw this rule from the planner without deleting it. A Cohort Type that still lists it is warned when it is saved.
fields.label: Is Active

name: Cohort Assignment Criterion
